page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Main text in one column, with a short marginal note on the right at the Vasquez passage. Left strip of the neighbouring page not transcribed.

main_text.p: dicit esse ὡς τέκνα[?], super utrosque. Deinde singulos ordines figillatim monet: Si servus es, plagas metue: si mercenarius, mercedem damnaxat[?] expectas: si denique filius, patrem reverere, ac bonis operibus stude; quia bonum est Patri obtemperare, [illegible, ~18 letters] Etiamsi ex eo re nihil tibi quaestus redituram sit: quia hoc ipsum merces est, nempe, Patri obsequi. Sic ille, docens has classes distingui debere, non confundi. Adversarii vero, ne omni Patrum antiquorum praesidio destituti esse videantur, tanquam homines aquis submersi, scirpos, & quidvis vel umbratile arripiunt; sed frustra, nisi quòd hoc modo nobis molestiam creare satagunt.

head.i: Objectio Adversariorum ex Patribus, Regnum coelorum ab iis dici VENALE, vehemens admodum, sed evanida.

main_text.head: Sect. V.
main_text.p: NON desistit Jesuita Vasquez nos quibusdam Patrum testimoniis premere, in quibus dicitur Coelum nobis proponi Venale: {•}Optimè (inquit) Jesuitae nostri Coloniensis docuerunt Coelum nobis proponi Venale, ea quòd meritis condigniis, tanquam pretio aequali, comparandum sit. Quam sententiam Kemnitius (hicVasquez in 1.2.Tom.2.disp.215.cap.2.

page.notes: Greek passages after "esse" and after "obtemperare," are only partly legible at this resolution; the Greek letters are marked [?] or illegible. "damnaxat" is uncertain. The small "Sect.5." printed beside the running head is a section mark, not part of the running head. A faint mark under "Kemnitius" at the foot is not a readable catchword. The text ends mid-parenthesis "(hic" and continues on the next page. The left strip with fragments of the neighbouring page was not transcribed.
